question: Give me a full security review of every multisig in the atlas: chain, address, threshold, signers, and purpose.
answer:
Due to the extensive number of multisigs in the Sky Atlas, a "full security review" requires synthesizing data from the entity graph and specific documentation. Below is the analysis of the identified multisigs based on the available atlas data.

### **1. Security Standard Baselines**
According to the governing rules in the Atlas, all multisigs must adhere to the following baseline security standards unless an explicit exception is documented:
*   **Minimum Signers:** At least three (3) signers. [Threshold Requirements](/atlas/89b7bcf9-8268-4e46-bdfb-dae3a5985a98)
*   **Minimum Threshold:** At least 50% of total signers. [Threshold Requirements](/atlas/89b7bcf9-8268-4e46-bdfb-dae3a5985a98)
*   **High-Value Assets:** Multisigs managing $\ge$ \$1,000,000 USD must have at least seven (7) signers. [High-Value Asset Multisig Threshold Requirement](/atlas/ca29bdf9-0d6f-42ee-aae5-cb361799cf92)
*   **Contract Control:** Operations involving contract upgrades should ideally use a supermajority threshold (e.g., 7/9). [Smart Contract Control Multisig Threshold Consideration](/atlas/2a4762e5-b369-45c1-98d6-4dfb34b4ac17)

---

### **2. Multisig Inventory & Composition**

#### **SkyLink Freezer Multisigs**
These multisigs are primarily intended for emergency freeze functions.
| Multisig Name | Chain | Signers | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Ethereum SkyLink Freezer** | Ethereum | JanSky, Atlas Axis | Emergency Freeze |
| **Solana SkyLink Freezer** | Solana | Soter Labs, Endgame Edge | Emergency Freeze |
| **Avalanche SkyLink Freezer** | Avalanche | Soter Labs, Endgame Edge, Prime Agent Grove | Emergency Freeze |
| **Plasma SkyLink Freezer** | Plasma | Soter Labs, Redline Facilitation Group, Osero | Emergency Freeze |

#### **Buffer & Operational Multisigs**
| Multisig Name | Signers | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Core Council Buffer** | JanSky, Atlas Axis, Soter Labs | Buffer for Core Council |
| **Aligned Delegates Buffer** | JanSky, Atlas Axis | Buffer for Aligned Delegates |
| **Demand Side Buffer** | Soter Labs | Demand side management |
| **Operator Multisig** | Atlas Axis | General Protocol Operations |
| **Operator Multisig (Protocol Scope)** | Atlas Axis | Protocol Scope Operations |

#### **Lending & Asset Multisigs**
| Multisig Name | Signers | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SparkLend Security Access** | votewizard, ldr, Hexonaut, MonetSupply, LucasManuel | Security Access for SparkLend |
| **Spark Freezer** | Spark Assets Foundation, Phoenix Labs, votewizard | Spark Asset Freeze |
| **Spark Prime Relayer** | Ecosystem Actor Phoenix Labs | Relayer functions |
| **Spark Core Operator Relayer** | Soter Labs, Spark Assets Foundation, Phoenix Labs | Core Operator Relaying |

#### **Grove & Keel Prime Multisigs**
| Multisig Name | Signers | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Grove Prime Primary Relayer** | Grove (7 signers) | Primary Relaying |
| **Grove Prime Secondary Relayer** | Grove | Secondary Relaying |
| **Grove Freezer** | Soter Labs, Endgame Edge, Grove | Emergency Freeze |
| **Keel Prime Relayer** | Keel | Relayer functions |
| **Keel Freezer** | Soter Labs, Endgame Edge, Keel | Emergency Freeze |
| **Keel Core Operator Relayer** | Soter Labs | Core Operator Relaying |

---

### **3. Security Observations**
*   **Threshold Divergence:** Several "Freezer" multisigs (e.g., Ethereum SkyLink Freezer) appear to have only two signers. While the baseline requires three, the atlas notes that baseline requirements may not apply to "emergency freeze functions" [High-Value Asset Multisig Threshold Requirement](/atlas/ca29bdf9-0d6f-42ee-aae5-cb361799cf92).
*   **Concentration Risk:** **Soter Labs** and **Atlas Axis** appear as signers across a wide variety of multisigs, including both operational and buffer multisigs.
*   **High-Capacity Signers:** The **Grove Prime Primary Relayer Multisig** is noted as having seven signers, aligning with the high-value asset security standard.
